sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. No.1557 of 2024 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., Khallikote, Ganjam arising out of Beguniapada P.S. Case No.358 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 34/420 of IPC read with Section 66(C)/66(D) of the I.T. Act.
3.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that the allegations are an offshoot of nonpayment of the installments of a vehicle and the same are made in an exaggerated manner.
Hence, the Petitioner may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer.

5. Taking into account the nature of allegation and the submissions made, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper.
6. It is needless to state that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
7. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
